2. The Civil Petition No. 69 of 2013 and Civil Petition No. 771 of 2013 are related to the shops No. 28 and 29, Salim Mansion, situated in plot No. 597 of khatian No. 534, mouza Sadipur under Sylhet Police Station. Landlord Abdul Mannan @ Laki Miah and others filed S.C.C Suit No. 7 of 2005 for eviction of their tenants Md. Imman Ahmed and others and realization of defaulted rents. On the other hand, tenant Md. Imman Ahmed instituted Rent Control Case No. 17 of 2005 before the Rent Controller and Senior Assistant Judge, Sylhet Sadar, for depositing rent for the month of November, 2004 and onwards to the Rent Controller. 

 3. On the other hand, Civil Petition No. 70 of 2013 and 772 of 2013 are related to Shops No. 34 and 35 of Salim Mansion situated in plot No. 597 of Khatian No. 5334 of Sadipur Mouza. Md. Abdul Mannan @ Laki Miah and others instituted S.C.C. Court No. 8 of 2005 for eviction of their tenant Md. Imman Ahamed. The tenant Md. Imman Ahmed instituted Rent Control Case before the Rent Controller for depositing rent.
